spans.s:
ढ 1. ढ, the aspirate of the preceding
letter; its use as an initial letter is very limited, and
several of the words in which it occurs can scarcely
be regarded as pure Sanskrit.
—ढ-कार, अस्, m.
the letter or sound ढ्.

ढ 2. ढ, अस्, m. an imitative sound; a
large drum; a dog's tail; a dog; a serpent; void of
qualities (?).
